Fairphone 6 is a smartphone designed and marketed by Fairphone, following its Fairphone 5.[1] It was announced as "The Fairphone (Gen. 6)"[2] on 25 June 2025.[3] The phone was originally only available in Europe for €599[4], however in October 2025 it was officially made available in the US for $899 through /e/OS creator Murena.[5] The phone comes with 5 years of warranty and 8 years of updates.[4]

Specifications

Fairphone 6 is a modular smartphone, making it easily repairable and customisable by the user. It supports 5G and Wi-Fi 6E connectivity, and has a 4,415 mAh user-replaceable battery. The phone is sold with 256 GB of storage and 8 GB RAM. It has a 50 MP camera with optical image stabilisation and a 13 MP ultra-wide lens, and an IP55 rating.[6][7] There are black, green, and white colour options.[8]

The phone ships with Android 15, with e/OS being available when the phone is purchased through the company website. Users can also switch to other operating systems.

Fairphone 6+

On 18 August 2026, a refreshed variant known as the Fairphone 6+ was released, marketed as the "The Fairphone (Gen. 6+)".[9] It ships with Android 16; other changes include a new processor (Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 from the 7s Gen 3), a boost in RAM capacity to 12 GB from 8 GB, and a new "Cobalt Blue" color option. This is the first Fairphone officially available in the United States.[10]
